page_notation: printed page / PDF page; PDF = printed + 2 in this file
registry_status: PRELIMINARY - verified against source PDF pages named below; not Elda-confirmed
scope_note: v1 covers H.78 hinged-door, two-door and drawer+jumbo base units (printed p.36, p.39). Sink (p.46-47), corner (p.44-45), waste, appliance and remaining drawer variants are NOT yet in this registry - extend only after reading their pages.

code_grammar.shape: B + depth_digit + width_field + config_suffix, e.g. B80601

depth_digit.note: FAMILY-SPECIFIC. Verified for H.78: 7=d.35, 8=d.62, 9=d.67 (printed p.36/PDF 38). H.58.5 differs: 6=d.47, 4=d.62 (printed p.35/PDF 37). Never reuse one family's mapping for another.

width_field.note: Lookup, not arithmetic: 45 maps to 05, 105 maps to 10. Verified printed p.36, p.39.

config_suffix.note: NOT globally unique: B80300 (pull-out door, W300) and B80600 (two-door unit, W600) share suffix 00. Decoding a code therefore requires the explicit code rows below; a suffix grammar cannot recover configuration. Verified printed p.36.

door_version.note: Each base-unit page shows door heights 78 and 75 over a single code table; gola takes the top 30 mm. Object Contract 4.1. Verified printed p.36/PDF 38.
door_version.elda_open: Order notation for the chosen version - Elda_Open_Questions Q1

hinge_side.note: Source states '1 rh or lh door' with one code per width; hinge side is a per-order choice. Contract v1.2. Verified printed p.36/PDF 38.

pricing_groups.note: Code tables carry price columns for groups 1-11. Group labels are structure only; no price is ever extracted (Object Contract 1.2).

base_drawers_jumbo.description: Base unit with drawers and jumbo drawer - 2 drawers, 1 jumbo drawer
base_drawers_jumbo.notes: Servo Drive referenced on the page as an option; drawer internals beyond the confirmed front layout are not established.

front_layout.note: Front heights from the elevation on printed p.39: 19,5 / 19,5 / 39 top to bottom (handle version; gola shows 18 / 18 / 36). Sum 780 = family door height.
front_layout.gola_note: Verified from the p.39 elevation (zoomed 2026-08-16): undercounter recess above the top drawer; plain joint between the two 180 drawers; intermediate recess between the second drawer and the jumbo. Top drawer opens from the undercounter zone, second drawer from below via the intermediate zone, jumbo from above via the same zone. A gola drawer unit therefore needs BOTH profiles: undercounter (GOL001/GOL005) + intermediate (GOL002/GOL006), same system.

hardware.gola_note: position=undercounter profiles (GOL001 L-shaped / GOL005 straight) are the valid choice for a base-unit front under the worktop; intermediate profiles join stacked front zones and are NOT offered for single-door base units. Source: 'Do not add 57 to carcass height' - the profile lives in the 30 mm gola zone, the carcass does not grow. Cross-restriction: handle Lume M00014 pairs with the straight system only.

gola_profile_body.note: Cross-section from the extract (printed p.615/620): upper dimension 30 fills the gola zone above the 750 door; full grip zone 57 below worktop, profile depth 27. Preliminary drawing shows the visible 30 mm strip at the front plane with front thickness; true section stays recorded here. Do not add to carcass height.
